description: Security descriptor for Enterprise SaaS Transformation Platform

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Platform owner: Manage catalog, risk templates, companies, and users

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manager
scopes.description: Enterprise IT Lead: Run assessments, set criteria weights, approve plans, view dashboard

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Analyst
scopes.description: Enterprise Analyst: Enter assessment data, run evaluations and risk analysis

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Viewer
scopes.description: Executive Stakeholder: Read-only access to recommendations, risks, and roadmap

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Company ID for multi-tenant data scoping

role-collections.name: Transformation_Admin
role-collections.description: Full administrative control of SaaS Transformation Platform

role-collections.name: Transformation_Manager
role-collections.description: Manager access to run assessments, set weights, and approve roadmaps

role-collections.name: Transformation_Analyst
role-collections.description: Analyst access to input assessments and run scoring evaluations
